title: Right-unit normalization of the actual compactification projection in comparison coordinates
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and f:X→Y a morphism of schemes with a specified compactification c. Work in the ambient unbounded small pro-etale derived categories of fixed A-module sheaves. Let F=Rf_!(c), S=Lf*, and tensor be the actual derived tensor of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let A_T be the comparison image of the ordinary constant complex and e_f:S A_Y≅A_X its canonical pullback identification [def-pur-finite-site-coordinates]. Let rho_M:M tensor A_X≅M be the canonical compared-coefficient right unitor [def-pur-affine-line-purity-coordinate-maps]. Then, for every M in D(X,A), the specified proper-counit/open-tensor projection [def-exchange-projection] satisfies PF(c;M,A_Y) followed by F((1_M tensor e_f) followed by rho_M) = rho_(FM). No boundedness, Tor, trace, exchange, composition comparison or projection invertibility assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Write f = pj for the supplied compactification and F = Rp_* j_!. Expand its published projection into the proper counit mate and Rp_* of the open tensor comparison, followed by the pullback compositor. Naturality is already built into this transformation. At the ordinary coefficient unit, the proper mate composed with Rp_* of the pullback-unit comparison and right unitor is the right unitor: transpose under Lp* adjoint Rp*, apply the tensor-unit identity of the canonical comparison and the counit triangle.

proof.text: Restrict the inverse open tensor comparison to j. Its normalization is the identity. Hence its specialization at the unit, followed by j_! of the pullback-unit comparison and right unitor, equals the right unitor of j_!M with the proper pullback-unit comparison inserted. To justify equality before restriction, identify the source with j_!M by its unit constraints; both arrows are then between objects in the image of the fully faithful j_!, and their restrictions are equal.

proof.text: The canonical pullback composition isomorphism identifies the successive pullback-unit comparisons for p and j with the pullback-unit comparison for f. Apply Rp_* to the open equation and substitute the proper equation. Transport the tensor unit by the exact comparison image of the ordinary constant unit. The maps pullbackUnit and moduleRightUnit in the fixed-scalar coordinates are precisely these identifications, giving PF(c;M,A_Y) followed by F(1_M tensor e_f;rho_M) = rho_(FM). The argument is on the ambient unbounded categories and does not require inverting PF at the unit.

theorem compactSupportProjection_rightUnit
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (M : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
    ((projectionMapOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).app M).app (unit A Y) ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).map
        (((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).obj M).map (pullbackUnit A f).hom ≫
          (moduleRightUnit A X M).hom) =
      (moduleRightUnit A Y
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c).obj M)).hom
